item.description: The Psychological Society of Ireland (PSI) has recently elected Dr Anton James as a Fellow of the Society, making him the first ever Sri Lankan psychologist to receive this prestigious honour.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] Seaspan Offers Growing Opportunities for Sri Lankan Seafarers
item.description: As global shipping continues to evolve, Seaspan remains committed to investing in the people who power its success. Through ongoing fleet growth, a strong focus on professional development, and a culture grounded in safety and innovation, Seaspan is creating new opportunities for seafarers around the world, including in Sri Lanka.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] Royal Nursing Home opens new Corporate Head Office in Colombo 07 marking new chapter in regional growth
item.description: Royal Nursing Home (Pvt) Ltd, one of South Asia’s leading elderly care service providers, has marked a new milestone in its growth journey with the inauguration of its new Corporate Head Office at No. 82, Barnes Place, Colombo 07, further strengthening the company’s administrative and operational capabilities as it continues to expand locally and internationally.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] Former CIMA Global President Aubrey Joachim Joins Nanaska to Shape Future Leaders
item.description: Nanaska, one of Sri Lanka’s professional education institutes specializing in the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) qualification, is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Aubrey Joachim, FCMA, CGMA, MBA, to its Board as a Non-Executive Director.

item.description: A last-minute order to scale back Ulchi Freedom Shield may have a limited immediate military effect. Its deeper cost is the precedent.

item.description: KUKA HOME, one of the world's largest integrated home furnishing companies, has opened its first showroom in Sri Lanka. item.description: Janashakthi PLC (JXG) reported its maiden first quarter financial year 2026/27 (Q1 FY27) results, marking its first reporting period since a successful IPO on the Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) that was oversubscribed by 3 times.

item.description: ජාත්‍යන්තර රතු නිවේදන නිකුත් කර සිටි සංවිධානාත්මක අපරාධ කල්ලි සාමාජිකයෙකු වන දිමුතු චතුරංග නොහොත් ‘සමිත්පුර චතු’ නැමැත්තා අද (18) අලුයම මෙරටට රැගෙනවිත් තිබේ. ඕමානයේදී අපරාධ පරීක්ෂණ දෙපාර්තමේන්තුවේ (CID) නිලධාරීන් කණ්ඩායමක් විසින් අත්අඩංගුවට ගන්නා ලද 28 හැවිරිදි මෙම සැකකරු මෙලෙස දිවයිනට රැගෙනවිත් ඇත. මිනීමැරුම්, බරපතළ අපරාධ, මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය ජාවාරම් සහ බෝම්බයක් සන්තකයේ තබා ගැනීම ඇතුළු චෝදනා රැසක් මොහුට එරෙහිව එල්ල වී තිබූ බව පොලිස් මාධ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශක සහකාර පොලිස් අධිකාරී එෆ්.යූ. වුට්ලර් මහතා සඳහන් කළේය.
